home.brandBody: PallasTrade is a self-hosted e-commerce platform that pairs a nimble, Pallas-cat-like storefront with enterprise-grade commerce under the hood. We curate premium everyday essentials, ship fast, and keep your data on your own servers — full control, no compromise.

home.faqSupportA: Reach us any time through the live chat widget or email — our team responds within 24 hours.
